input.value: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
Vehicle totaled; trunk crushed into back seat

input.rationale: Motor vehicle collision with documented property damage and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly within auto coverage.
Vehicle is totaled (well above $25,000 loss), and claimant sustained multiple injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) that warrant immediate adjuster attention and medical documentation.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report.
